game.ap2.turf_wars.description: Two teams try to claim the whole map with their turf. Killing opponents expands a teams turf. Build a fort on your turf between fights.
game.ap2.turf_wars.phase.build.hint: The build time hase begun. Fortify your turf against arrows! Blocks on lost turf will be deleted.
game.ap2.turf_wars.phase.fight.title: Fight!
game.ap2.turf_wars.speed_up: Speed up! Kills now expand your turf by %s blocks.
game.ap2.turf_wars.camp_warning: Return to your turf! Otherwise, your team will be eliminated in %s seconds.
game.ap2.turf_wars.eliminated_for_campin: %s was eliminated because they didn't enter their turf for %s.
game.ap2.turf_wars.kit.assassin.descript: Assassins can enter enemy turf and have an iron sword. Arrows are two-hit.
